name: Hijirigaoka Lisa
source: The new half-Japanese, half-Italian teacher who arrives into the school when [url=/c47159]Rikurou's[/url] demon blood starts activating. An expert exorcist from Vatican, she has a lot of experience dealing with all kinds of demons (mainly around Europe). Teaches English and is a master at the three languages - English, Italian and Japanese. Despite her mature appearance, Lisa's personality is somewhat innocent. She is also very stubborn, and when she puts her mind on something, she won't stop until she's done with the said goal.
